items.title: Self-Indexing Latent Memories for Access-Aware Continual Instruction Tuning of LLMs
items.title_zh: 自索引潜在记忆：面向 LLM 的访问感知持续指令微调
items.summary: TILA-CT is a replay-free continual instruction-tuning method that gives each task a latent memory and adapter bank in a frozen LLM, with the memory's persistent state serving as the routing prototype for a shared prompt-only router. On an 8-task CT-Pipeline stream it reaches 65.19 acquisition and 63.98 final macro score with 1.38 points of average forgetting, and final macro routing accuracy is 93.9%.

items.title: MicroSim: Contrastive Graph Neural Networks for Binary Code Similarity Detection
items.title_zh: MicroSim：用于二进制代码相似性检测的对比图神经网络
items.summary: MicroSim represents each function as a graph built from IDA Pro Hex-Rays microcode and compares such graphs with a contrastive Siamese graph neural network. On the TREX cross-optimization benchmark with 849,072 function-level microcode graphs and a strict class-disjoint split, it reaches 0.9972 ROC-AUC and 0.9762 MCC, outperforming Gemini, SAFE and jTrans retrained on the same split.

items.title: Same Error, Different Recovery: How Delivery Changes LLM Agent Behavior
items.title_zh: 相同错误，不同恢复：错误呈现方式如何影响 LLM 智能体行为
items.summary: A study across 13 open models from 3B to 70B parameters finds that the same tool error can lead to different retry, correction or stop behavior depending on how it is delivered. Retaining the failed exchange in a new user turn avoided severe stopping failures in Llama models and, as an opt-in recovery layer on ToolMaze, raised success on explicit errors by 14.2 points for 7-8B models and 10.5 points for 32-70B models.

items.title: GOPR-CAD: Graph-of-Operations Progressive Reasoning for CAD Generation
items.title_zh: GOPR-CAD：面向 CAD 生成的运算图渐进推理
items.summary: GOPR-CAD is an agentic text-to-CAD pipeline in which a language model acts as a decision agent over encapsulated CAD operations and progressively builds an executable operation graph that a deterministic compiler converts into the final model. It reaches 82.7% structural yield on the new 300-part MHCAD benchmark and 87.2% on an external CADPrompt subset.

items.title: Data-informed Adaptation of Foundation Models for Causal Effect Estimation
items.title_zh: 面向因果效应估计的数据知情基座模型适配
items.summary: MoE-Learner embeds a dataset under multiple assumption-specific views and uses the variogram of the embeddings as a counterfactual-free router to assess each causal expert's validity. It achieves the best average rank on the IHDP, ACIC and Lalonde benchmark datasets.

items.title: LocateAnyMesh: Grounding 3D Mesh Queries in 2D Images with Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: LocateAnyMesh：用视觉语言模型在二维图像中定位三维网格查询
items.summary: LocateAnyMesh is a vision-language model that takes a textured 3D mesh as part of its prompt, using a frozen 3D encoder and a learned connector to place mesh tokens alongside image and instruction tokens. LAM-Select improves localization on real-image suites and the official BOP YCB-V evaluation without rendered query views or object-specific fine-tuning.

items.title: InfraRSI: Harnessing Recursive Self-Improvement for Training Infrastructure
items.title_zh: InfraRSI：利用递归自我改进优化训练基础设施
items.summary: InfraRSI is an agentic harness that turns human commands into verified training optimizations through a five-stage workflow covering scope locking, profiling, co-optimization, verification and audit.

items.title: ScottDuncanAI/PID-to-Knowledge-Graph
items.title_zh: PID-to-Knowledge-Graph：把 P&ID 图纸转换为工艺知识图谱
items.summary: PID-to-Knowledge-Graph is a Python Claude skill that converts P&ID PDFs, whether digital or scanned, into a process knowledge graph capturing flow, instruments and control loops.

items.title: DriveFoundry: Co-Evolving Data and Model for Efficient Closed-Loop Iteration in Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: DriveFoundry：面向自动驾驶高效闭环迭代的数据与模型协同演化
items.summary: DriveFoundry is a closed-loop autonomous-driving framework that couples structured causal data refinement with adaptive inference, building traceable scene-candidate records and using verified model failures to guide annotation. Its 9B Xiaomi-Drive-o1 model reports the lowest ADE@1 on PhysicalAI among tested models, and adaptive inference matches full reasoning performance using only 28% of tokens.
